name: Research Communication and Professional Ethics in Chemistry
description:
1. Foundations of Scientific Method and Reasoning: Inductive vs Deductive Reasoning, Oral research presentations, literature survey (using scientific search engines), research article reading and drafting, Poster presentations.
2. Research & Academic Integrity: types of plagiarism (direct, self-plagiarism, inadvertent plagiarism), Paraphrasing versus copying, proper attribution, ethical use of AI in academic writing. Literature review - methodologies and standard tools. Research methodology - problem formulation, design/implementation, evaluation. Chemical structure designing. Misconducts: Fabrication, falsification, manipulation of data/images, Selective reporting, salami slicing, Unethical authorship practices (ghost authorship, gift authorship, predatory publishing)
3. Chemical safety concept - recognize chemical hazards, Assess the risks from the hazards, minimize and manage the risks, and prepare for the unexpected and emergencies.
